The app's Quit (POST /shutdown, kill.stop("all", QUIT_REASON)) stops the planning call before the store closes. The page after a Quit therefore reads 'Planning failed: planning was stopped before it finished.', not the crash sentence; this is the 'killed' words of intakeFailureWords, which cannot tell a Quit from Stop now. Bench evidence: scratchpad/b3walk/after.log. The brief is kept and Try again works either way. Whether a Quit should read 'Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' is a words choice for the session lead.

Pre-existing, not caused by this branch: Change the plan, and Reject followed by Draft a new plan, on a plan drafted from an Add to brief still draft from the project's first brief. A filed card does not keep its brief. proposeNow uses opts.brief ?? summary_cache.brief; Change the plan's enqueue (intake.ts, the 'changed' answer) passes only {changes, read}; retry from 'rejected' passes {}. A fix would keep the brief on the card (change_card.brief) and draft from it.

The stand-in's plan does not depend on the brief, so on the bench the right brief shows only in the model-call log, never on the card. The live check should confirm the card's tasks fit the Add to brief.
